discussion.title: Official SBOM availability and release-level dependency traceability for F´
discussion.bodyText:
Hello F´ maintainers,
I'm conducting independent, reproducible research on software supply-chain transparency and Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) for open-source flight software.
Following a separate SBOM research exercise involving NASA's Core Flight System (cFS), I would like to understand the corresponding practices for F´.
Before proceeding, could you please clarify:
Does F´ publish an official or maintainer-supported SBOM in SPDX, CycloneDX, or another format?
If available, where is it published, and how is it associated with specific releases or commits?
Are the F´ framework, FPP, development tools, GDS, and third-party dependencies covered separately or together?
If no official SBOM is currently published, is there a recommended approach for generating a reproducible, release-bound inventory from public project sources?
Would the maintainers welcome a separately scoped, independently generated SBOM for technical review?
The proposed research would be read-only, use public sources, and clearly distinguish independently generated evidence from official project artifacts.
The immediate purpose is to establish the authoritative dependency and release boundaries before any further security analysis.
Thank you for your guidance and for maintaining F´.
Best regards,
Thales Rangel
Independent Software Security Researcher
ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0629-9731

nodes.bodyText: The F Prime build system generates an SBOM using syft if it is installed on the build host https://github.com/nasa/fprime/blob/devel/cmake/target/sbom.cmake

Thank you for the clarification and for pointing me to the CMake SBOM integration.
This is very helpful for establishing a reproducible baseline.
I'll examine the Syft-generated SPDX JSON output against a pinned F´ revision, with particular attention to dependency coverage, provenance, and reproducibility.
I'll keep the study independent and clearly distinguish build-generated artifacts from officially published release SBOMs.
Thank you again for your guidance.
Best regards,
Thales Rangel
Independent Software Security Researcher
ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0629-9731
